notes: Repeated calls only stat the file and verify five 64-byte fingerprints; they do not re-read the 6.7 MB log.
Appending one message parses only the new line (unit test spies on _apply_chat_row: 1 call).
Old evidence is resolved by ID on demand and then cached in a bounded 400-entry LRU.
The legacy full read+parse column measures only the read/parse work the old implementation repeated every call; it excludes the old full SHA-256.
